fieldNotes.truckGate: Very large foam-manufacturing complex enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence (privacy slats visible on the SW and NW sides in 2026-02 Street View). A facility of this scale and 24/7 operation with full perimeter fencing has a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Could not be visually confirmed - the internal plant entry road off the Alcovy Rd signalized intersection has no Street View coverage and z20/z21 satellite over the entry/office is overexposed. No booth positively identified. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the basis that a gate exists but no guard booth was visible; this is uncertain because the gatehouse could not be inspected.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Sprawling multi-section plant; dock doors and backed-in trailers are distributed along the SE/east faces. Estimated ~40-50 doors -> 25-50 band. Count is a rough estimate over a very large footprint.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard on the SE between the plant and the eastern neighbor; dozens of trailers parked in rows plus more along the south edge -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive dedicated trailer-storage areas on the SE/south aprons -> true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Plant is large enough that shipping and receiving almost certainly run from separate dock clusters on different faces; inferred from scale, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Covington GA - the Alcovy Rd / I-20 industrial corridor is small-town/edge-of-town industrial bordered by woods. Per rubric, small-town industrial -> Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; foam thermoforming plant served entirely by truck.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Reads as one large interconnected manufacturing complex (single building cluster) -> false. The separate large building to the east is a different facility.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Generous paved width at the entry and large internal aprons leave physical room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~52 acres, derived from the perimeter box; large flagship foam plant.
